treeNodes.2: BRANCH: eight child trees; child index xBit | yBit<<1 | zBit<<2
treeNodes.3: DENSE: size^3 nonnegative int32 dictionary IDs; X fast, Z rows, Y planes
treeNodes.4: PALETTE (v2 only): uint8 count, ascending distinct int32 dictionary IDs, packed uint32 words

packedLeaf.indexOrder: X fast, Z rows, Y planes
packedLeaf.bitOrder: index i starts at bit i*bitsPerIndex, least significant bit first across words

coverage: indexed zero-length payload is logical EMPTY; unindexed position is not archived
